cause_quote: The shared registration added `.option("--on-exit-cwd <path>", "Working directory for the --on-exit watched command")` to `cron edit` and switched it to `resolveCronEditScheduleRequest(opts)`, where the stream patch branch returned before the flag-pair check.
user_saw: A cron edit with both --stream-cwd and --on-exit-cwd but no --on-exit reported success, changed the stream working directory, and silently ignored --on-exit-cwd.
summary: The fix moves validation of --on-exit-cwd into schedule normalization so an invalid flag combination is rejected before any stream update.
reasoning: I checked the stream feature and the option registration diffs: stream metadata edits already existed, and --on-exit-cwd was accepted only by cron add before PR #128373. The first version that accepted the flag on cron edit passed it to a resolver whose stream metadata branch returned before the existing validation, so the defect shipped with CLI support for that flag on edits.
